# Milo

> Milo plans a night out. Tell Milo the mood, and Milo shapes the plan. Milo is an early prototype and Bengaluru-first.

Milo is not a dating app. Bookings and on-ground support are handled by real people. In-app booking and reminders are not live yet. Milo does not take payments.

## Pages

- [Landing page](https://www.aaryanshah.co.in/): what Milo is, how it works, quick answers
- [Landing page as Markdown](https://www.aaryanshah.co.in/index.md): the same facts in plain text
- [Prototype](https://www.aaryanshah.co.in/app/): try the early prototype in your browser
